name: project_status
prompt: Here's the project tracking doc for Project Phoenix: [link]. Write a status brief for the executive team. We are currently 2 weeks behind schedule but have mitigated the risk by hiring two contractors.

name: recurring_update
prompt: Give me the weekly update for the Marketing Campaign. Here is the thread from last week, and the new metrics: CTR is up 5%, spend is exactly the same, and no new vendors were signed.

name: decision_brief
prompt: Brief me on the decision between Vendor A (cheaper, slower support) and Vendor B (more expensive, 24/7 SLA). The engineering team prefers B, but finance wants A to keep costs down. Give me a recommendation.
